track: Rockwell-NVIDIA Fall 2026 - Dataset 3: Grasping and Sorting
instruction: pick one countersunk screw and drop it in the yellow bin
frames: Positions are in the robot base frame (x forward, y left, metres). Yaw is the screw axis about +z, degrees.

stages.name: none
stages.rule: the fingers never reach the screw

stages.name: reach
stages.rule: a fingertip touches the screw or ends within 10 mm of it

stages.name: grasp
stages.rule: the screw is lifted at least 10 mm off the surface

stages.name: transport
stages.rule: the screw is carried over the bin opening

stages.name: place
stages.rule: the screw rests inside the bin and the gripper has opened

scoring.success: stage 4 within max_trial_s, with no operator intervention and no controller fault
scoring.cycle_time_s: start of the trial to the moment the operator stamps stage 4, successful trials only
scoring.ci: Wilson 95% interval on the success rate
